title: Restore access to Settings and Color Palette on workspace/channel screens
summary: The owner asked how to open Settings or Color Palette. Product Development Lead replied with the gear locations and stated the UI change was local/uncommitted at the time. Commit 538857e later added the settings dropdown to desktop Channels, desktop workspace home and mobile Channels; it is an ancestor of HEAD b39dca3, whose committed sources retain those entry points. This closes the implementation/access request. Live visual verification and release status are not evidenced, so follow-up remains for runtime confirmation.
nextAction: Product Development Lead or Release Engineer should confirm the current client exposes the gear and opens Color Palette on desktop Channels/workspace home and mobile Channels, then record release status; no matching task appears in the supplied tasks snapshot.
